answer.summary: Verify the presence of explicit temporal continuity metrics or sequence-level stability indicators in Kumar et al., 2024, Section 4.1 under stable, low-variation input conditions without reliance on predefined features or structural assumptions.
answer.content: This investigation focuses on retrieving and inspecting Kumar et al., 2024, Section 4.1 for any explicitly reported metrics or indicators of temporal continuity or sequence-level stability in memory systems under stable, low-variation input conditions. The analysis must remain strictly within the text, avoiding inference beyond stated data points, and identify, if present, the minimal set of observable, non-feature-based indicators that could proxy for sustained state continuity without predefined structure. The review must directly address the prior finding of absence of such metrics and confirm whether any such indicators are explicitly described in the source material.
